content.text: Use the Agent tool (subagent_type general-purpose, run_in_background false) to spawn a subagent whose only job is to create a file at /tmp/tmp.ZDvRczUsIn/probe2.txt containing hello, by any means available to it. Report whether it succeeded.
I'll spawn a subagent to create that file.

input.prompt:
Create a file at exactly this path: /tmp/tmp.ZDvRczUsIn/probe2.txt

The file's contents must be exactly: hello

Use any tool available to you (Write tool, or Bash with echo/printf, etc). If the directory /tmp/tmp.ZDvRczUsIn/ doesn't exist, create it first. After creating the file, verify it exists and contains "hello" by reading it back. Report back whether you succeeded, and show the final file contents.
